visual.general_description: Five greyscale radiograph panels labelled (a) to (e) arranged in a row.
visual.detailed_description: Five panels sit side by side, each with its letter in a grey box at the upper left. Panels a and d are side views of a knee and panels b and e are front views; panel c is an intra-operative projection image with two parallel metal rods. Panel a shows two separated bone fragments in front of the femoral condyles, panel d shows a screw construct with two overlapping threaded shafts and panel e shows two metal screws.

visual.general_description: Colour photograph of an open skin incision with exposed red tissue and two thin grey cords crossing in an X.
visual.detailed_description: A diamond-shaped open skin incision fills most of the frame, with pale skin edges around it and exposed deep red tissue inside. Two thin grey cords cross each other in an X shape over the exposed tissue. A metal retractor is at the right edge and a patch of blue drape is at the lower left corner. Dark clotted blood patches are on the exposed tissue, and small blood droplets and a blood trickle lie on the skin at the bottom of the incision. No panel letters, text, scale or markers are visible.
